# Published schema 23 save

The published Natural Causes WebAssembly module wrote `day-two.sav` on November 20, 2026. The capture called `SimHandle.from_lot_with_seed(20260728, 0)`, advanced 1,441 ticks, and wrote the bytes returned by `save_bytes()` verbatim. The existing WebAssembly host bindings instantiated the published module without import changes. [Published module](https://natural-causes.life/assets/terri_wasm_bg-D1ZRm3Bp.wasm)

The saved household has two days of bill accounting and a fading aquarium mood lift for Sim 1 ending at tick 1,457.
